reviews.title: Great Budget GPU
reviews.comment: Works great. Haven't had any issues and it been almost 6 months now. It was the fastest GPU I could run with my old school 8350 FX. It allowed my kids to play all their new video games on it. For its price point, it was a steal.
reviews.author: A Foti

reviews.title: Fast Enough. Reasonably Affordable.
reviews.comment:
I got this to update my wife's gaming PC. As a "cozy gamer" she doesn't (yet?) need it, but she wanted to upgrade her PC a bit because we had torn her office apart while we cleaned and moved furniture. So, I replaced an older 750-Ti with this, and I increased RAM from 16 to 32 GB.
I tested the Sapphire card with the usual gaming stability and burn-in testers. No hiccups, and temps under full load were tolerable. I had to dig out a DP-to-DVI adapter to connect her secondary monitor.
Not sure of the "modern" Sapphire as a company (warranty), but I have had good luck with the brand in past decades. Fingers crossed.
Her PC? While playing the Sims 4 and Wylde Flowers, no detectable performance difference, as expected.  :)
But if she ever decides to play Skyrim, or something similar, I'm sure I will see some kind of difference.
Until then, another Sapphire card FTW. Plus, I now have a bit of a backup card if my venerable 1080-Ti ever incinerates (it's undervolted and over-cooled to prevent that).
reviews.author: K. Kleinschmidt

reviews.title: It's a good 1080p gpu
reviews.comment:
Seemed sketchy at first but I took the plunge and bought one. GPU-Z reports it as legit, AMD drivers recognize it as legit, BIOS reports it legit, and benchmarks are on par with other 6650xt cards.
In terms of performance this card is pretty good for the price of $210 (at the time of purchase). Solid choice for 1080p and you'll definitely manage to crank out 60+ FPS on modern AAA games, even on max or near max settings, and you'll obviously get much more on older/simpler games. Also this card runs cools, peaking at most at 75-79 celsius even while stress test benchmarking.
Solid GPU and I'd recommend since it's around $10-$20 cheaper then other 6650xts on the market (at time of purchase) and still being from AMD's best AIB, Sapphire, it has very solid build quality.
reviews.author: Cindy N

reviews.title: Real good lower midrange GPU.
reviews.comment: A good performing graphics card with few extras. No RFB. No artistic flair. That’s what’s good. Save money on a graphics card that looks like a graphics card. If you want fancy then you aren’t interested in these lower end graphics anyway. Great card for the money. To me it’s on par with my MSI RTX 3070 I have in my other system.
reviews.author: Mark

reviews.title: This card needs to Breathe.
reviews.comment: Runs on the warm side. Have to run custom fan tune through AMD adrenaline. By default, zero rpm fan IS Enabled. So the cooling is passive up to 40C. vanilla Skyrim on ultra settings locked at 60 fps. Gets up to 75c playing other titles. Underclocked it to reduce heat.  Probably case selection for my heat issue. My b450m ds3h is a single pcie16 main board and cpu basement is one inch below, exhausting straight up. A big upgrade from an rx580. IM happy with it 1 year later.
